idea.title: AI wedding speech writer for best men and maids of honor

source.text: An AI app that writes a personalized wedding speech for best men and maids of honor, $19 per speech. Countries US then FR. Budget 0, 5 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug wedding-speeches.

idea.problem: Best men and maids of honor must give a personal, funny, moving speech and most dread writing it.
idea.customer: Best men and maids of honor (US, mostly aged 25-35) with a wedding 1-6 weeks away
idea.solution: A web app that interviews the user about the couple and generates a personalized speech with AI
assumptions: Budget USD 0: no paid ads, only free tiers and organic channels
5 hours a week, solo founder, side income goal
No audience, network or wedding-industry asset (stated: no special edge)
Founder can build a simple web app with an LLM API (not stated; assumed from the idea)
Type saas: an AI web app, sold one-off per speech
US first, France second, as stated

answers.question: Do you already have an audience, a list or a wedding-industry partner?
answers.answer: Not asked (headless run, user said just go). Assumed no: the user stated no special edge.
answers.effect: no change: no_distribution stays a hit

gross_margin.note: About 94% after Stripe 2.9% + 30c and ~$0.20 of LLM per speech; lowered from 5 by R4 (profit capped at 2)

ltv_cac.note: LTV ~$19.7 (one purchase) vs paid CAC ~$35 ($0.70 CPC / 2%): 0.56, below 1

pricing_power.note: Free ChatGPT sets the anchor at 0; look-alikes sell at $0.99-$9.99 and still earn ~$10 a month

build_effort.note: A form plus an LLM call plus Stripe Checkout: 1-3 weeks at 5 h/week

skills_match.note: Skills not stated; assumed able to ship a simple web app, copywriting and SEO skills unknown

capital_needed.note: Free hosting tiers, pay-per-transaction Stripe, cents of LLM per speech: fits a $0 budget

sales_cycle.note: Deadline-driven impulse purchase: buyer decides the same day, weeks before the wedding

channel_readiness.note: No audience, $0 ads, wedding subreddits ban self-promotion, SEO owned by big wedding sites

search_demand.note: 2.13M US marriages in 2024 (CDC), about 2 speeches each; 'best man' gets 40,500 searches a month

trend.note: Marriages flat to slightly up (US 2.04M to 2.13M; France 241k to 251k); keyword trend unknown

willingness_to_pay.note: Humans get $100+ on Fiverr, but AI-only tools earn $5-$311 all-time: buyers expect AI drafts free

free_alternatives.note: ChatGPT (900M weekly users) and free generators do the whole job; R1 applied

competitor_density.note: 9+ near-identical AI speech writers on Product Hunt, App Store and Show HN; capped by R1

differentiation.note: No edge stated; a guided form over an LLM is what every look-alike sells; capped by R1

legal_regulatory.note: GDPR on guest data, AI Act Art. 50 disclosure, FR 14-day withdrawal waiver at checkout: work, not a blocker

platform_dependency.note: Depends on Google SEO, where AI Overviews halve clicks (8% vs 15%), and on one LLM API

market_risk.note: Weddings recur every year; but 44% of 2026 couples say AI has no place in speeches

skills.note: No stated skills in copywriting, SEO or wedding content

assets.note: No audience, data or wedding-industry network (stated: no special edge)

interest.note: Stated goal is side income, not a passion for weddings or speechwriting

rules_applied.effect: free ChatGPT does the whole job, no edge: free_alternatives 1, competitor_density 2.5 -> 2, differentiation 1.5; competition 1.5
LTV:CAC 0.56 with no fix at $0: gross_margin 5 -> 4, profit 2.0
no channel and LTV:CAC 0.56: cap 49, score already 44

tam.reasoning: 2,128,446 US marriages (CDC 2024) x 2 speeches (best man + maid of honor) x $19

sam.reasoning: TAM $80.9M x 36% of couples using AI in planning (The Knot 2026)

som.reasoning: SAM $29.1M x 0.1% (solo founder, no channel); look-alikes show far less: Wedding Speech AI $311 in 10 months

price.reasoning: user's stated price, one-off per speech

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: Stripe 2.9% x 19 + 0.30 = 0.85, plus ~$0.20 LLM (about 25k tokens incl. 3 revisions on a mid-tier model)

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: One-off purchase; a person gives 1-2 wedding speeches in a lifetime, so there is no recurring revenue to churn

expected_lifetime.reasoning: 1 speech per buyer, ~10% give a second one later (assumption, no data found)

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: Cold paid click to $19 one-off purchase: 1-3%; WordStream's 7.5-8.2% average is mostly lead forms, not purchases

cac.reasoning: CPC $0.70 ('best man', Keywords Everywhere) / 2% conversion; at the $5.26 Google Ads average CPC it is $263

payback_months.reasoning: One-off: gross profit per customer $19.7 lifetime is below the $35 CAC, so paid acquisition never pays back

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: Domain ~$12/year; hosting and database on free tiers; Stripe has no monthly fee

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: Fixed $1 / gross profit $17.95 per sale = 0.06, rounded up to 1; the problem is reach, not cost

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 3 weeks to build at 5 h/week + 4-6 weeks for organic posts or SEO to bring a first buyer

tam.reasoning: 251,000 marriages (INSEE 2025 provisional) x 2 temoin speeches x EUR 19

price.reasoning: user's price converted; local templates sell at EUR 4.90 (Payhip), so the anchor is far lower

cac.reasoning: No French CPC found for 'discours temoin'

verdict.launch_reason: The US has 8x more marriages (2.13M vs 251k) and price anchors in dollars; France anchors at EUR 4.90 template packs.

type_checks.note: One-off purchase, ~1 speech per lifetime: no recurring revenue; AI apps also churn 30% faster than non-AI apps (RevenueCat 2026)
Zero switching cost: the same prompt works in free ChatGPT, which has 900M+ weekly users (OpenAI, 2026-02)

verdict.cheapest_test: Rescue path: a $59 Fiverr gig for an AI-drafted, human-edited best man speech in 48 h; stop at fewer than 3 inquiries by day 7.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 buyer inquiries on the Fiverr gig by day 7 -> stop
0 paid orders by day 14 -> archive the idea
Delivery takes more than 2 hours per speech by order 3 -> stop (5 h/week ceiling)

rescue.change: Sell a $59 AI-drafted, human-edited speech service on Fiverr instead of a $19 self-serve app
rescue.why: Fiverr's buyer traffic fixes no_distribution; the human edit beats free ChatGPT and lifts pricing_power and ltv_cac
rescue.effort: 1 week to set up, ~1.5 h per speech
rescue.requires: Good writing in English; capped at ~10 speeches a month at 5 h/week

rescue.change: Pivot to a ceremony-script tool for wedding officiants and celebrants, sold as a subscription
rescue.why: Officiants write dozens of scripts a year: fixes the one-off churn_benchmark hit and ltv_cac
rescue.requires: Reaching officiants (associations, directories) without an existing network

confidence.note: Exact search volume and CPC for 'best man speech' and 'discours temoin' (Keyword Planner) would firm up CAC

narrative.answer: **NO-GO** at 44. A free ChatGPT prompt does the job, and look-alike tools earn about **$10 a month**. With $0 and no audience, no channel reaches buyers for less than the ~$20 one-off value.
tldr: Free ChatGPT (**900M weekly users**) and free generators already write a personalized speech, so $19 buys only convenience.
The look-alikes with verified revenue earn almost nothing: Wedding Speech AI made **$311 all-time**, LoveLetterLab $5.
One purchase per lifetime and a paid CAC of about $35 give **LTV:CAC 0.56**: every paid customer loses money.

key_findings.title: ChatGPT does the job for free
key_findings.detail: With **900M+ weekly users** (2026-02) and free speech generators like InsertChat, a $19 AI draft competes with zero.

key_findings.title: Look-alikes earn about $10 a month
key_findings.detail: Wedding Speech AI has Stripe-verified revenue of **$311 all-time** and $9.98 in the last 30 days (TrustMRR, 2026-11).

key_findings.title: Paid search loses money on every sale
key_findings.detail: At a $0.70 CPC and 2% conversion, CAC is about **$35** against an LTV of $19.7 from one purchase: LTV:CAC 0.56.

narrative.recommendation: Archive the $19 AI app. If you want one test, run the 7-day Fiverr test of a **$59 human-edited** speech service, and stop at fewer than 3 inquiries.
narrative.steelman: Demand is real and deadline-driven: **2.13M US marriages** in 2024, about 2 speeches each, and Fiverr speechwriters charge from $100. The margin is 94%. But the money goes to humans: the AI-only tools with public revenue sell almost nothing, so the steelman supports a service, not the app.

premortem.cause: No channel brought buyers: SEO is owned by The Knot-type sites and wedding subreddits ban self-promotion
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 100 visitors and 0 sales in the first 30 days

premortem.cause: Visitors tried the free preview, then wrote the speech in free ChatGPT
premortem.early_signal: Under 1% of the first 200 visitors pay

premortem.cause: Each buyer pays once, so no channel could cost more than about $18 per customer
premortem.early_signal: Any paid test shows CAC above $19, and 0 repeat buyers

changes.what: ChatGPT passed 900M weekly users and 50M paying subscribers: the free substitute is mainstream
AI use among engaged couples nearly doubled to 36% (The Knot Real Weddings Study 2026)
Zola First Look 2026: 44% of couples say AI has no place in wedding speeches
Google AI Overviews cut clicks to regular results from 15% to 8% (Pew, 900 adults)
Small LLMs fell to about $0.50 per million output tokens, so cloning a speech tool costs nothing

why_now.note: The window opened in 2023 and is closing: cheap models made the job free, and SEO clicks are shrinking.

icp.who: US best men and maids of honor, roughly 25-35, 2-8 weeks before the wedding, who dread public speaking
where: Fiverr best man speech category (293 gigs)
icp.pays_for_today: Mostly nothing (free ChatGPT, free examples); some pay Fiverr writers from $100 or a speechwriter $275
icp.budget: unknown; $0 for an AI draft, $100-$275 for a human writer
icp.trigger: Being asked to be best man or maid of honor, then the last weeks before the wedding

customer.segment: Best men and maids of honor with a wedding 1-8 weeks away (US first)
customer.pain: They must be funny and moving in front of 100+ guests and don't know how to write it
customer.today: Free ChatGPT, free example articles, or a $100+ human writer on Fiverr

free_alternative.evidence: ChatGPT (900M+ weekly users, 2026-02) and free tools like InsertChat's wedding speech generator write a full personalized speech at no cost.

strong_competitor.evidence: No competitor meets the traction bar: Speechy, the most visible, has 131 Trustpilot reviews and claims 1,000 speeches sold in year 1 (2024).

graveyard.evidence: LoveLetterLab (AI speech generator, 2024) made $5 all-time with no active subscriptions; Wedding Speech AI fell from $61.50 a month (2026-01) to about $10.

no_distribution.evidence: With $0 ads, paid CAC (~$35) exceeds LTV ($19.7); wedding subreddits ban self-promotion and free example sites fill the search results.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Clear: Stripe 2.9% + 30c plus ~$0.20 of LLM per speech leaves a 94% gross margin.

weak_demand.evidence: Clear: US marriages rose from 2.04M (2023) to 2.13M (2024, CDC) and France from 241k to 251k (INSEE 2025); keyword trend not found.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: Clear but real work: AI Act Art. 50 disclosure from 2026-08, GDPR on guest anecdotes, and a French 14-day withdrawal waiver at checkout.

saturated_wave.evidence: 9 near-identical AI wedding speech tools found (Product Hunt, App Store, Show HN), but only 1 datable to the last 12 months: below the 10-in-12-months bar.
